title: Waluipedia Mass Import / Export
description: Export every actor (with its folder path) to one JSON or into a Data-folder tree (one file per actor, subfolders = Actors folders), and import a JSON, a repo packet, a URL, or a whole Data directory back in: subfolders detected, a review table to untick / rename / move before anything changes, folders rebuilt, existing actors updated in place by id, images checked. The Foundry end of the Waluipedia repo bridge (tools/foundry-bridge.py).
